description.en_US: Phone-style screen time tracking. Focus accounting via Quickshell's native ToplevelManager (event-driven, pauses while locked, suspend gaps not counted): today's per-app seconds, hourly histogram, and a 30-day daily history. A separate 'AI work time' dimension samples the CPU of agent process trees (claude/codex by default) every 10s and counts sessions actually working — even unfocused or locked — with parallel-session peak and sum. Bar pill with today's total and a hover popup (top apps, yesterday comparison, AI work time); detail panel via IPC with hourly/7-day/30-day charts, per-app ranking, and an AI section; optional sidebar quick-toggle tile (Tier B patch) that opens the detail panel.
description.zh_TW: 手機風格的螢幕使用時間統計。以 Quickshell 原生 ToplevelManager 做焦點記帳（事件驅動、鎖屏暫停、休眠時段不入帳）：今日各應用秒數、每小時直方圖、30 天每日歷史。另有獨立的「AI 工作時長」維度：每 10 秒取樣 agent 程序樹（預設 claude/codex）的 CPU，統計真正在工作的 session——即使未聚焦甚至鎖屏——含並行峰值與合計。Bar 藥丸顯示今日總時長，hover 彈窗含 Top 應用、昨日比較與 AI 工作時長；IPC 開啟詳情面板（時段/7 天/30 天圖表、應用排行與 AI 區塊）；可選側欄快速開關磁貼（Tier B 補丁），點擊開啟詳情面板。

patches.content:
DelegateChoice { roleValue: "screentime"; AndroidQuickToggleButton {
        required property int index
        required property var modelData
        buttonIndex: root.startingIndex + index
        buttonData: modelData
        editMode: root.editMode
        expandedSize: modelData.size > 1
        baseCellWidth: root.baseCellWidth
        baseCellHeight: root.baseCellHeight
        cellSpacing: root.spacing
        cellSize: modelData.size
        name: Translation.tr("Screen time")
        tooltipText: Translation.tr("Screen time")
        buttonIcon: "hourglass_bottom"
        toggled: false
        mainAction: () => Quickshell.execDetached(["qs", "-c", "ii", "ipc", "--any-display", "call", "screentime", "toggleDetails"])
    } }
